_note: Names are normalized first (NFKC, lowercase, katakana->hiragana, symbols/spaces removed, 0->o 1->i 3->e 4->a 5->s 7->t @->a $->s, repeated letters collapsed). 'contains' blocks a name that includes the word anywhere; 'exact' only blocks a name that is exactly the word (short words that hide inside innocent names). Words here are normalized the same way before comparing.
